info.name: Slash Infotech CRM - Task Attachment Storage & Security (Phase 6.3.6)
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API Collection covering all attachment endpoints of Phase 6.3.6: Multipart Binary Upload, Attachment Listing, Authenticated Binary Download, Inline Preview (strict CSP), Authorized ClamAV Rescan, and Soft Deletion. Enforces 25MB disk spooling, magic-byte inspection, zero disk extraction ZIP/macro validation, ClamAV antivirus scanning, SHA-256 integrity verification, and complete client isolation.

request.description: Uploads a binary attachment using disk spooling (.tmp_spool/) with a 25MB limit. Executes magic-byte validation, zero disk extraction ZIP/macro checks, and ClamAV scanning. Stores SHA-256 checksum and scan status.
Lists all active attachments for a task, returning metadata including filename, MIME type, file size, SHA-256 checksum, scan status, collection, and uploader info. Scope-filtered.
Streams binary file from private storage with Content-Disposition: attachment. Rejects with 423 Locked if scanStatus is not CLEAN. Rejects clients with 403 Forbidden.

Renders supported formats (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP) inline with strict Content-Security-Policy (default-src 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'none'; script-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none';). Non-previewable formats return 400 Bad Request. SVG and HTML are forced to download. 423 Locked if non-clean.

Triggers an authoritative ClamAV TCP rescan for an attachment currently in PENDING, FAILED, or QUARANTINED status. Enforces SCANNING concurrency lock and validates pre/post SHA-256 checksum to detect tampering. Only authorized users with tasks.approve, tasks.review, or Admin/SuperAdmin can execute.
Soft-deletes attachment and associated Media record. Only uploader, assigned manager, or admins can delete. Blocks future download or preview.
